description: Ask what an x402 endpoint charges without paying: fetches the URL, parses the 402 requirements, says which option this wallet would pay (chain, asset, amount, recipient), whether the per-payment cap, the spend policy and the rolling budgets would allow it, and nothing is signed. Call it before pay_x402 when the price is unknown.

body.description: Optional request body, as for pay_x402

headers.description: Optional JSON string of request headers, as for pay_x402

method.description: HTTP method the real request would use

prefer_chain.description: Preferred chain ID when several are offered

name: quote_x402
